family: Trim_N=family.evaluate on ALL N bits: exact alpha=1/(1-beta), default SU capacity floor(floor(K^beta)/(L_j+1)^12), inverse-capacity responses, public plateau/tail rows and variable active gaps, first-tie minimum stage source certificate. Uniform P/empty-witness NP verifier in proof.md. Fallback output0,u_N=N+1.
theorem: For each fully guarded plan, source_certificate computes u(p)=min(d_plan,c_H+1+sum_u[T_u*(I_u-1)+(O-1)]), where actual-map entropies and geometric stage targets O,I_u are defined by(ST) in proof.md. The controller selects least u(p), uniformly in polynomial time. C_B2(Trim_N)>=4N-8u_N+4 for EVERY integer N>=0. At EVERY sufficiently large integer N, u_N<=2^ceil(D_trim Z), D_trim=139829/50000=2.79658, Z=ceil(L^(3/4))*ceil(B^(1/4)),L=ceil(log2 N),B=ceil(log2(L+1)). Consequently for each fixed epsilon>0, C_B2(Trim_N)>=4N-N^epsilon at ALL sufficiently large integer lengths and this SAME fixed eligible family has liminf C_B2(Trim_N)/N>=4.
